dashboard.workspace.employeeDescription.en: This portal helps you complete your employee onboarding data and supporting documents.
dashboard.workspace.employeeDescription.id: Portal ini membantu Anda melengkapi data onboarding karyawan dan dokumen pendukung.

dashboard.workspace.candidateDescription.en: This portal helps you review your active applications and complete the profile details required during the recruitment process.
dashboard.workspace.candidateDescription.id: Portal ini membantu Anda meninjau lamaran aktif dan melengkapi detail profil yang dibutuhkan selama proses rekrutmen.

dashboard.tip.message.en: For the smoothest experience, we recommend filling out this form on a laptop or computer. Also, don't forget to click "Save Draft" before leaving the page so your progress isn't lost.
dashboard.tip.message.id: Untuk kenyamanan saat mengisi, kami sarankan menggunakan laptop atau komputer. Jangan lupa juga klik tombol "Simpan Draf" sebelum meninggalkan halaman agar data yang sudah diisi tidak hilang.

dashboard.applications.empty.en: There are no applications linked to this account yet.
dashboard.applications.empty.id: Belum ada lamaran yang terhubung dengan akun ini.
